Treatment summary
Patient presented flolowing a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes. The reported
mechanism is consistent with the symptoms described, and the presentation is plausible for a crash of this type. Initial evaluation
documented concussion with headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. Imaging and examination
findings clearly confirm the diagnosis. The patient has no known prior injury to the head or neck region.
Care over 21 visits included symptom monitoring, vestibular and oculomotor exercises, graduated return-to-activity guidance,
and cognitive rest recommendations. The course followed a typical recovery pattern, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms
improved. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate entries.
At the most recent evaluation, the patient reported substantial improvement and near-resolution of symptoms. Discharge from
active care is anticipated pending final symptom check. Follow-up as needed is advised if symptoms recur.
